input: Sign up for a community sailing course

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Sailing courses vary widely — beginner keelboat, dinghy, racing, coastal navigation — and the right type determines which programmes to look at.
Whether this is for the user alone, a child, or a group changes eligibility requirements, course formats, and scheduling.
The user's location (city, coast, inland lake) determines which sailing clubs or community centres actually offer relevant courses nearby.
Budget limits which programmes are feasible; some community courses are subsidised or free, others cost hundreds of dollars.
Availability — weekends only, evenings, a specific season — narrows which course schedules are actually compatible.
Whether the user wants an accredited certification (e.g. RYA, ASA) versus a casual intro experience shapes which providers to prioritise.
Knowing what 'done well' looks like — booked and paid, or fully researched with options shortlisted — defines the immediate next action needed.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a community sailing course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enrol in a local sailing course offered through a community programme.

questions.title: What type of sailing course are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants a beginner dinghy, keelboat, racing, coastal, or another type of sailing course.

questions.title: Who is this course for — you, a child, or a group?
questions.description: Determine whether the enrolment is for the user individually, a minor, or multiple people, as this affects eligibility and course format.

questions.title: What city or area should the course be near?
questions.description: Establish the user's location to identify relevant local sailing clubs, community centres, or waterfront programmes.

questions.title: What is your budget for the course fees?
questions.description: Understand the user's financial limit to filter between free community programmes, subsidised clubs, and full-price sailing schools.

questions.title: Which days or times are you available to attend?
questions.description: Determine scheduling availability — weekdays, weekends, evenings, or a specific season — to match compatible course timetables.

questions.title: Do you want an officially certified qualification from the course?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a recognised certification such as RYA or ASA, or simply a casual introductory sailing experience.

questions.title: What does success look like — fully enrolled or options shortlisted?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is to be completely signed up and paid, or to have a researched shortlist of suitable courses ready to review.
